title: darkniche — package design
text: Directional niche coverage, climatic dark diversity, threshold-sweep null-model diagnostics. R port ddniche Python pipeline (v2.1) underlying Rahimi & Jung (Iran companion study, review) global ecoregion study.

title: darkniche — package design
text: Data-agnostic core. package ships range polygons, ecoregion shapefile, rasters. Users bring point sets cell scores shared environmental space; package never downloads anything. IUCN polygons WWF shapefile inputs user’s workflow, package data (large licence-encumbered bundle). vignette demonstrates full workflow, published results 619 ecoregions bundled via dn_data() every example runs real output. Numerical fidelity. Every core function reproduces Python reference float32 precision, enforced golden tests generated actual ddniche code (tests/testthat/test-golden.R, tools/make_golden.py). Passing golden tests package’s correctness claim; future refactor must keep green. Guardrails API, prose. two field-tested failure modes encoded objects : dn_aggregate() returns reliable = FALSE (suppresses SES/enrichment) expected count < 5, dn_sweep() prints direction-reversal warning verdict flips across thresholds. dn_cddr() computes area-adjusted residual alongside raw ratio documents raw CDDR must never used rank regions. Base R first. v0.1 zero hard dependencies beyond base + stats. terra Suggests-(users projecting rasters). Rcpp backend dn_density()/dn_metrics() v0.2 optimisation API frozen — profiling shows pure-R KDE handles package’s intended per-study scale (102–104 objects) comfortably; 21.7M-pair global run remains Python pipeline’s job.

title: darkniche — package design
text: dn_null_shift(targets=) accepts explicit target cells draw can reproduced exactly (used golden tests; also lets users share seeds across languages). Default behaviour draws availability-weighted targets. dn_dark(p_min = 0.177): default externally calibrated Youden threshold source studies’ species-blocked, climate-establishment model. documented calibration; users applying different metrics/models must recalibrate via dn_calibrate() validation positives. dn_sweep() returns classed object printing console Rmd silently drop reversal warning. Array layout: densities R x R matrices indexed [x, y] (Python’s first axis = x). Flat vectors inside package R column-major; golden tests handle C-order conversion explicitly document .

title: darkniche — package design
text: GBM establishment model (sklearn pipeline): scope; calibrated threshold provided documented constant, dn_calibrate() covers recalibration. glm-based equivalent candidate v0.2. Tail-refined permutation p-values (utils.permutation_p refinement): dn_null_breadth()/dn_null_summary() return floored empirical p . SES, null mean SD — quantities dark-diversity rule uses — golden-tested; refined p yet ported. TODO(v0.2). 3-D lattice (niche.PCSpaceND): sensitivity-analysis machinery, core. TODO(v0.2) behind API (dn_space(ndim = 3)). Figures: package plots sweep; publication figures stay user scripts.

title: darkniche — package design
text: Golden tests (56 assertions): lattice construction, KDE vs scipy gaussian_filter (< 2e-7), envelopes entry quantiles (exact), twelve pair metrics (< 5e-6; float32 reference), shift null injected targets (exact q; < 2e-4 auc, limited reference’s float32 weight storage), SES flooring (exact), aggregate test incl. reliability flags (exact), breadth-matched null (< 1e-6), containment phenomenon papers’ Figure 1 (DNC_q ≈ 1, DNC_auc ≈ 0.9, D ≈ 0.08 engulfing-niche pair). Real-data reproduction (pre-release gate): run tools/export_golden_real.py actual pipeline store dump ~20 species x 10 ecoregions real densities metrics, confirm R port reproduces published table values. step needs files authors’ machine (see ).

title: darkniche — package design
text: Kept deliberately, found test rather reading: dn_sweep() used unreliable thresholds verdict (fixed 0.1.0 release). reversal detection, printed ratio range plotted curve computed finite ratios, including rows dn_aggregate() suppressed effect size expected count five — diagnostic report exactly numbers test refuses report. three now use reliable rows , attr(x, "n_reliable") exposes count. Regression test: “sweep verdict never uses cells test calls unreliable”. dn_auc() returned NaN single-class labels (fixed 0.1.0). validation set negatives produced NaN silently, scripted workflow propagates results table without signal something went wrong. dn_auc(), dn_delong() dn_calibrate() now stop message naming problem, dn_auc() also checks score label equal length. Regression test: “degenerate inputs fail loudly rather returning nonsense”. dn_cddr() warned constant ratio. cor() emits zero-standard-deviation warning every region ratio; confound_r now NA case report plot say “estimable”. README verification snippet run written (fixed post-release, documentation ). Two problems, found user pasting fresh session rather test: metric example printed values unseeded draw, printed output never matched comment; told reader run testthat::test_local(system.file(package = "darkniche")), fails R install package’s tests unless INSTALL_opts = "--install-tests" passed. Documentation examples quote expected output must either seeded must quote output. CFI_w cell-ordering. Mahalanobis weight grid must enumerated order flattened density. R densities flatten column-major (x fastest, matching expand.grid); Python fixtures C-order (x slowest). golden test builds grid fixture ordering documents .

title: Climatic dark diversity with darkniche: a quickstart
text: package ships range polygons rasters — inputs (IUCN, BirdLife, WWF, WorldClim). ship real published output.
code: # 1. one lattice from the global background (e.g. two climate PCs) sp <- dn_space(global_scores, R = 100)  # 2. one density per species and per region, same bandwidth for all Zs <- dn_density(species_scores, sp) Ze <- dn_density(region_scores,  sp)  # 3. the metric block m <- dn_metrics(Zs_matrix, Ze_matrix, q = 0.95)  # 4. null screens Zg  <- dn_density(global_scores, sp) nul <- dn_null_shift(Zs, Ze_matrix, Zg, B = 499) dn_null_summary(m$DNC_auc, nul)  # 5. calibrate the admissibility threshold on documented introductions neg <- dn_match(positives, regions, reached) thr <- dn_calibrate(scores, labels)  # 6. classify pairs <- dn_dark(pair_table, p_min = thr, ses_cols = c("n1_ses", "n2_ses"))

what: 5. Guardrail 2 — check the threshold before claiming a direction
title: Climatic dark diversity with darkniche: a quickstart
text: region-level test counts species threshold compares count Poisson-binomial expectation null. Results whose expected count falls five reported : direction verdict often property threshold rather region:  Across 619 bundled ecoregions: data support opposite worldwide conclusions depending threshold put. Report sweep, single value.
code: obs <- c(rbeta(300, 0.3, 5), rbeta(100, 9, 1.1)) mu  <- rbeta(400, 2.5, 2.5); sdv <- 0.18 + 0.06 * runif(400) dn_aggregate(obs, mu, sdv, threshold = quantile(obs, 0.95)) #>   n_species n_admissible_obs expected       sd       ses         p enrichment #> 1       400               20  19.5729 3.981904 0.1072604 0.4572912   1.021821 #>   reliable #> 1     TRUE sw <- dn_sweep(obs, mu, sdv) sw #> Threshold sweep of the aggregate null test #>   thresholds: q0.80 - q0.99 (20 points) #>   obs/expected ratio: 0.235 - 1.699 #>   ** DIRECTION REVERSES across the sweep: a single-threshold #>      verdict for this region is an artefact of the threshold. ** plot(sw) cen <- dn_direction_census(dn_data("sweep")) cen$census #>   quantile n_enriched n_depleted #> 1     0.80         71        548 #> 2     0.90        344        275 #> 3     0.95        520         81 #> 4     0.99        449          3 sprintf("%d of %d reliably testable ecoregions change direction (%.0f%%)",         cen$n_changed, cen$n_regions, 100 * cen$frac_changed) #> [1] "439 of 452 reliably testable ecoregions change direction (97%)"

code: library(darkniche) set.seed(1)  # 1. the bundled global results load, and reproduce the published summary eco <- dn_data("ecoregion") nrow(eco)                                    #> 619 round(range(eco$cddr), 3)                    #> 0.022 0.924 round(cor(eco$cddr, log10(eco$area_km2)), 3) #> -0.441  # 2. the algebraic identity the package rests on: no symmetric statistic can #    express containment, because sum(min(Zs, Ze)) IS Schoener's D sp <- dn_space(cbind(rnorm(3000), rnorm(3000)), R = 60) Zs <- rbind(as.numeric(dn_density(cbind(rnorm(800, 0, 1.4),                                         rnorm(800, 0, 1.4)), sp))) Ze <- rbind(as.numeric(dn_density(cbind(rnorm(300, 0, 0.25),                                         rnorm(300, 0, 0.25)), sp))) m <- dn_metrics(Zs, Ze) all.equal(as.numeric(m$DNC_min), as.numeric(m$D))   #> TRUE round(c(D = m$D, DNC_q = m$DNC_q, DNC_auc = m$DNC_auc), 3) #>       D   DNC_q DNC_auc #>   0.149   1.000   0.730 # D is low although the region is habitable throughout; only the directional # forms say so.  # 3. the diagnostic fires on the real data dn_direction_census(dn_data("sweep"))$census #>   quantile n_enriched n_depleted #> 1     0.80         71        548 #> 2     0.90        344        275 #> 3     0.95        520         81 #> 4     0.99        449          3
